text:
I scored v1, the only registered version, on the test set. It is a 3-seed ensemble of U-Net convnext_tiny models trained with dice_ce loss, run with 8-view test-time augmentation (TTA).

| Score | mIoU |
|---|---|
| Validation | 0.7765 |
| Test | 0.7573 (95% CI 0.7402–0.7718) |

The test score is 0.019 below validation, and the validation score is just above the top of the test CI. Seed-to-seed noise was only about 0.0007, so it doesn't explain a gap this size. I'm reporting the gap as it is and made no attempt to improve the test score.

I wrote two lessons:
1. **Test gap:** expect about 2 points of shrinkage from validation to test on this multi-class task. Judge small gains against the CI width, not the seed standard deviation.
2. **Untried levers:** every registered run stopped on the time budget before finishing its epochs, and the ensemble+TTA gain (+0.0087 on validation) is smaller than the test CI. Before stacking more seeds or TTA, try higher resolution, a class-weighted loss for barren and roads, or longer training.
